# Plan

The MCF7-SIX1 versions of two MDA-MB-231 figures, both at hypoxia 1hr:

- **(A)** as in `02_`: Liu's nascent-protein log2 fold change on METTL13 KO (T3M4, Table 2A),
  with MCF7-SIX1 eIF3d-promoted mRNAs in orange, the size-matched negative control in black and
  all other detected proteins in grey.
- **(B)** as in `03_`: MCF7-SIX1 TE log2(sictrl / si3d), split by Liu's call on the protein -
  **dDENP** (newly made protein falls on METTL13 KO, P < 0.05), **uDENP** (rises),
  detected-unchanged, and not detected.

Gene sets are the ones used in `07_`: `mcf7six1_hypoxia_3d_promotes_TE_1hr_lfc0.5.csv`
intersected with `feature_matrix_tco_mcf7six1.rds`, and a `set.seed(9)` draw of the same size
from `mcf7six1_3d_negative_controls_lfc0.5.csv` (|TE| < 0.5 and padj > 0.3 in both hypoxia and
normoxia) with positives removed. No saved MCF7-SIX1 classifier draw exists, so the draw is
made here exactly as in `07_`.

# Load

```{r load}
liu_csv <- here("output", "translational_control_overview", "liu2026_eef1a_k55me2",
                "liu2026_table2a_denps.csv")
if (!file.exists(liu_csv)) stop("Run 01_import_denps_volcano.Rmd first: ", liu_csv, " not found")
liu <- read_csv(liu_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)
stopifnot(
  nrow(liu) == 2364L, !anyDuplicated(liu$uniprot), all(is.finite(liu$log2fc)),
  identical(as.integer(table(liu$denp)[c("dDENP", "uDENP", "Unchanged")]), c(672L, 163L, 1529L))
)

# Promotes-positive MCF7-SIX1 table (written by 10m_): te_lfc = -source_log2FoldChange
te <- read_csv(here("output", "translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_mcf7six1_hypoxia_1hr.csv"),
               show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(gene_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id))
stopifnot("te_lfc is not the negated source LFC" =
            isTRUE(all.equal(te$te_lfc, -te$source_log2FoldChange)))
te_tested <- te %>% filter(!is.na(te_lfc), !is.na(te_padj))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(te_tested$gene_id_clean), all(is.finite(te_tested$te_lfc)))
cat("MCF7-SIX1 genes with a TE estimate:", nrow(te_tested), "\n")

pos_csv <- read_csv(here("output", "genesets", "mcf7six1_hypoxia_3d_promotes_TE_1hr_lfc0.5.csv"),
                    show_col_types = FALSE)
neg_csv <- read_csv(here("output", "genesets", "mcf7six1_3d_negative_controls_lfc0.5.csv"),
                    show_col_types = FALSE)
matrix_genes <- readRDS(here("output", "translational_control_overview",
                             "feature_matrix_tco_mcf7six1.rds"))$gene_id_clean
```

## Check: contrast direction

The MCF7-SIX1 table has no RNA column, so EIF3D's own knockdown cannot be used as the ruler.
Instead the gene set must be exactly te_lfc > 0.5 and padj < 0.05 in the promotes-positive
table, as asserted in `07_`.

```{r direction}
expected_pos <- te_tested %>% filter(te_lfc > 0.5, te_padj < 0.05) %>% pull(gene_id_clean)
stopifnot(
  "gene set is not te_lfc > 0.5 & padj < 0.05 in the promotes-positive table" =
    setequal(expected_pos, pos_csv$ensembl_gene),
  "gene set should be labelled promotes-positive" = all(grepl("promotes-positive", pos_csv$gs_description)),
  all(abs(neg_csv$te_lfc) < 0.5), all(neg_csv$te_padj > 0.3),
  length(intersect(pos_csv$ensembl_gene, neg_csv$ensembl_gene)) == 0
)
```

## Size-matched negative draw

```{r draw}
pos_genes <- pos_csv$ensembl_gene[pos_csv$ensembl_gene %in% matrix_genes]
pool      <- neg_csv$ensembl_gene[neg_csv$ensembl_gene %in% matrix_genes & !neg_csv$ensembl_gene %in% pos_genes]
stopifnot("negative pool not larger than the positive set" = length(pool) > length(pos_genes))

set.seed(params$neg_seed)
neg_genes <- sample(pool, length(pos_genes))

cat("Positives in matrix:", length(pos_genes), "of", nrow(pos_csv),
    "| pool:", length(pool), "| drawn:", length(neg_genes), "\n")
stopifnot(length(pos_genes) == 832L, !anyDuplicated(neg_genes))
```

# Map Liu proteins to genes

UniProt -> Ensembl gene via `org.Hs.eg.db` (`r as.character(packageVersion("org.Hs.eg.db"))`),
as in `02_`/`03_`, joined to the MCF7-SIX1 genes with a TE estimate. A protein encoded by more
than one distinct tested gene symbol (histone H4: one protein, several H4C genes) cannot be
attributed to one mRNA; it stays grey in (A) and is dropped from (B). A gene hit by two proteins
with different DENP calls is dropped from (B).

```{r map}
map <- AnnotationDbi::select(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = liu$uniprot, keytype = "UNIPROT",
                             columns = "ENSEMBL") %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  filter(!is.na(ENSEMBL)) %>%
  distinct(uniprot = UNIPROT, gene_id_clean = ENSEMBL) %>%
  inner_join(te_tested %>% dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, symbol), by = "gene_id_clean")

spot <- c(P60228 = "EIF3E", P14174 = "MIF", P52895 = "AKR1C2", O75955 = "FLOT1")
stopifnot("UniProt spot-check failed" =
            all(map_lgl(names(spot), ~ spot[[.x]] %in% map$symbol[map$uniprot == .x])))

multi_symbol <- map %>% group_by(uniprot) %>%
  summarise(n_sym = n_distinct(symbol), symbols = paste(unique(symbol), collapse = ","),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_sym > 1)
cat("Proteins encoded by >1 distinct tested gene symbol:", nrow(multi_symbol), "\n")
print(multi_symbol)
map_ok <- map %>% filter(!uniprot %in% multi_symbol$uniprot)
cat("Liu proteins placed on an MCF7-SIX1 tested gene:", n_distinct(map_ok$uniprot), "of", nrow(liu), "\n")
```

# (A) Nascent-protein change by MCF7-SIX1 eIF3d group

```{r cdf_protein, fig.width = 6.5, fig.height = 4.5}
prot_group <- map_ok %>%
  mutate(group = case_when(gene_id_clean %in% pos_genes ~ "eIF3d-promoted",
                           gene_id_clean %in% neg_genes ~ "Negative control")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(group)) %>%
  distinct(uniprot, group)
stopifnot("a protein maps to both groups" = !anyDuplicated(prot_group$uniprot))

grp_levels <- c("eIF3d-promoted", "Negative control", "All other proteins")
grp_colors <- c("eIF3d-promoted" = "#E69F00", "Negative control" = "black",
                "All other proteins" = "grey70")

liu_lab <- liu %>%
  left_join(prot_group, by = "uniprot") %>%
  mutate(group = factor(replace_na(group, "All other proteins"), levels = grp_levels))
stopifnot(nrow(liu_lab) == nrow(liu))

n_by    <- table(liu_lab$group)
grp_lab <- setNames(sprintf("%s (n = %s)", grp_levels,
                            trimws(format(as.integer(n_by[grp_levels]), big.mark = ","))), grp_levels)
xa <- split(liu_lab$log2fc, liu_lab$group)
stopifnot(length(xa[["eIF3d-promoted"]]) > 30, length(xa[["Negative control"]]) > 30)

w_pn <- wilcox.test(xa[["eIF3d-promoted"]], xa[["Negative control"]])
w_po <- wilcox.test(xa[["eIF3d-promoted"]], xa[["All other proteins"]])
w_no <- wilcox.test(xa[["Negative control"]], xa[["All other proteins"]])

p_a <- ggplot(liu_lab, aes(log2fc, colour = group)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
  stat_ecdf(linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = grp_colors, labels = grp_lab, breaks = grp_levels, name = NULL) +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf, hjust = 1.05, vjust = -0.6, size = 3.4,
           label = sprintf("promoted vs neg ctrl: Wilcoxon p = %s\nmedian %.3f vs %.3f",
                           format.pval(w_pn$p.value, digits = 2),
                           median(xa[["eIF3d-promoted"]]), median(xa[["Negative control"]]))) +
  labs(x = "log2 fold change in nascent protein, sgMETTL13 vs sgControl",
       y = "Cumulative fraction",
       title = "METTL13 KO nascent proteome (Liu 2026, T3M4)",
       subtitle = "Groups: eIF3d TE, MCF7-SIX1 hypoxia 1hr") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.02, 0.98), legend.justification = c(0, 1),
        legend.background = element_blank())
p_a

if (isTRUE(params$save_plots))
  ggsave(here("plots", "liu2026_09_cdf_nascent_protein_mcf7six1_eif3d_promoted_hypoxia_1hr.pdf"),
         p_a, width = 6.5, height = 4.5)
```

```{r stats_a}
tibble(
  comparison  = c("promoted vs negative control", "promoted vs all other", "negative control vs all other"),
  median_diff = c(median(xa[["eIF3d-promoted"]]) - median(xa[["Negative control"]]),
                  median(xa[["eIF3d-promoted"]]) - median(xa[["All other proteins"]]),
                  median(xa[["Negative control"]]) - median(xa[["All other proteins"]])),
  wilcoxon_p  = c(w_pn$p.value, w_po$p.value, w_no$p.value)
) %>% knitr::kable(digits = 4)

liu_lab %>% dplyr::count(group, denp) %>% group_by(group) %>%
  mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>% dplyr::select(-n) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = denp, values_from = pct) %>% knitr::kable(digits = 1)
```

# (B) MCF7-SIX1 TE change by Liu DENP call

```{r cdf_te, fig.width = 6.5, fig.height = 4.5}
gene_calls <- map_ok %>%
  inner_join(liu %>% dplyr::select(uniprot, denp), by = "uniprot") %>%
  group_by(gene_id_clean) %>%
  summarise(n_calls = n_distinct(denp), denp = dplyr::first(denp), .groups = "drop")
conflict <- gene_calls %>% filter(n_calls > 1)
cat("Genes with conflicting calls (dropped):", nrow(conflict), "\n")
gene_calls <- gene_calls %>% filter(n_calls == 1)

ambiguous_genes <- map$gene_id_clean[map$uniprot %in% multi_symbol$uniprot]

den_levels <- c("dDENP", "uDENP", "Detected, unchanged", "Not detected")
den_colors <- c("dDENP" = "#CC79A7", "uDENP" = "#0072B2",
                "Detected, unchanged" = "grey40", "Not detected" = "grey70")

plot_b <- te_tested %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, symbol, te_lfc, te_padj) %>%
  filter(!gene_id_clean %in% c(ambiguous_genes, conflict$gene_id_clean)) %>%
  left_join(gene_calls %>% dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, denp), by = "gene_id_clean") %>%
  mutate(group = factor(case_when(denp == "dDENP" ~ "dDENP", denp == "uDENP" ~ "uDENP",
                                  denp == "Unchanged" ~ "Detected, unchanged",
                                  TRUE ~ "Not detected"), levels = den_levels))
n_b <- table(plot_b$group)
print(n_b)
stopifnot(all(n_b[c("dDENP", "uDENP")] > 50))
den_lab <- setNames(sprintf("%s (n = %s)", den_levels,
                            trimws(format(as.integer(n_b[den_levels]), big.mark = ","))), den_levels)

xb  <- split(plot_b$te_lfc, plot_b$group)
w_d  <- wilcox.test(xb[["dDENP"]], xb[["Detected, unchanged"]])
w_u  <- wilcox.test(xb[["uDENP"]], xb[["Detected, unchanged"]])
w_du <- wilcox.test(xb[["dDENP"]], xb[["uDENP"]])

p_b <- ggplot(plot_b, aes(te_lfc, colour = group)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
  stat_ecdf(linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = den_colors, labels = den_lab, breaks = den_levels, name = NULL) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = quantile(plot_b$te_lfc, c(0.005, 0.995))) +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf, hjust = 1.05, vjust = -0.4, size = 3.2,
           label = sprintf(paste0("Wilcoxon vs detected, unchanged:\n",
                                  "dDENP p = %s, uDENP p = %s\n",
                                  "dDENP vs uDENP p = %s"),
                           format.pval(w_d$p.value, digits = 2),
                           format.pval(w_u$p.value, digits = 2),
                           format.pval(w_du$p.value, digits = 2))) +
  labs(x = "TE log2 fold change, sictrl vs si3d (hypoxia 1hr)",
       y = "Cumulative fraction",
       title = "eIF3d TE change by METTL13 KO call",
       subtitle = "MCF7-SIX1 TE; DENP calls from Liu 2026 (T3M4)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.02, 0.98), legend.justification = c(0, 1),
        legend.background = element_blank())
p_b

if (isTRUE(params$save_plots))
  ggsave(here("plots", "liu2026_09_cdf_te_mcf7six1_hypoxia_1hr_by_denp.pdf"), p_b,
         width = 6.5, height = 4.5)
```

The x range is clipped to the central 99% of genes for display; the statistics use every gene.

```{r stats_b}
plot_b %>% group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), median_te_lfc = median(te_lfc),
            pct_eif3d_promoted = 100 * mean(te_lfc > 0.5 & te_padj < 0.05), .groups = "drop") %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 3)
```
